name: Staked USD Coin
oneLiner: HedgeCore sUSD is the transferable BSC wrapper over hedge-locked hUSDC staking receipts; unwrapping is disabled with exit via the operator or PancakeSwap.
collateral: USDC supplied to the Venus Protocol USDC lending market on BNB Chain via HedgeCore's StrategyRouter and Venus USD vault; the tracked sUSD wraps hedge-locked hUSDC staking receipts held by the HUSDCWrapper, whose operator can sweep them out to treasury; the on-chain vUSDC lending position is the only backing (no fiat reserve or attestation)
pegMechanism: USDC deposits mint hedge-locked hUSDC, HedgeCore's transfer-restricted staking token whose deposits route into Venus lending; the one-way HUSDCWrapper mints transferable sUSD 1:1 against wrapped hUSDC with no unwrap function, and sUSD transfers are ordinary ERC-20 transfers except while a wrapper vesting lock is active. The issuer's sUSD page lists the tracked contract as the sUSD token and markets it as transferable liquidity tradable against USDC at an indicative 1:1 rate on PancakeSwap. Issuer materials conflict on labels and direction: introductory docs describe sUSD as soul-bound and hUSDC as tradeable, while the contract repository implements the tracked sUSD as the tradeable wrapper minted one-way from hUSDC. Venus interest accrues in vUSDC and is distributed by operator-triggered rewardMint() calls (93% to sUSD holders, 7% protocol fee). Redemption is operator-controlled rather than a free liquid backstop, and the wrapper operator can burn holder balances and sweep the wrapped hUSDC.

notices.title: Disabled unwrap and operator-controlled exit
notices.message: HedgeCore markets sUSD as transferable liquidity, but unwrapping is disabled: there is no holder-initiated redemption, exit relies on PancakeSwap USDC liquidity, and the wrapper operator can burn balances and sweep the wrapped hUSDC backing.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: HedgeCore sUSD is a USDC-funded lending receipt over a Venus position, with operator-controlled redemption rather than borrower debt.
